name: How long does a typical home restoration project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical home restoration project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a home restoration project varies significantly depending on the extent of the damage, the size of the property, and the specific services required. Minor repairs might take a few weeks, while extensive structural rebuilds could span several months. Factors like insurance approvals, material availability, and the complexity of custom finishes also influence the timeline. We work to provide a realistic project schedule early in the process, keeping homeowners informed of key milestones and potential adjustments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on damage extent, property size, and services needed; minor repairs take weeks, extensive rebuilds months.
